title: Interest engine withdrawal failed
description: This event occurs when a withdrawal is invalid and cannot be redeemed with product interest engine.

tracking_id.title: Tracking ID.
tracking_id.description: Unique withdrawal identifier defined by Customer.

account_id.title: Pismo's account identifier
account_id.description: Account ID generated by Pismo's platform that uniquely identifies an account within your organization.

external_account_id.title: Client's account identifier
external_account_id.description: External account ID informed by the client that uniquely identifies an account within your organization.

net_amount.title: Net amount requested
net_amount.description: Net amount the customer requested to withdraw.

withdrawal_date.title: Withdrawal date
withdrawal_date.description: Withdrawal date informed in the request. Serialized as a local date (yyyy-MM-dd).

available_balance.title: Net available balance
available_balance.description: Net balance available to be withdrawn from account

org_id.title: Organization identifier
org_id.description: Organization (tenant) identifier from the x-tenant header. May be null when the header is absent.

program_id.title: Program identifier
program_id.description: Program identifier from the x-program-id header. May be null when the header is absent.

message.title: Error message
message.description: Description of error that occurred when trying to register new withdrawal
examples: This deposit does not have any more available units.

created_at.title: Created date
created_at.description: Creation date of withdrawal on Pismo platform
